title: List environments
summary: List reusable environment templates for session runtime setup.

title: Create environment
summary: Create a reusable environment template for session containers, package policy, sandboxing, and network access.

parameters.name: hosting_type
parameters.description: Where session work runs. The published config.type spelling of the same field is also read, and sending both with different values is refused. An update that names one spelling replaces the stored spelling in the other, so an environment stored with the published spelling can be repaired from this form. cloud means the platform decides: sessions provision on the workspace's configured default backend, which the response reports as effective_sandbox_provider.

parameters.name: config
parameters.description: Published CMA configuration. config.type is read as hosting_type (config.type: "cloud" runs sessions on the workspace's configured default backend), config.networking is normalized into the recorded local network key names, and config.packages is preserved without being installed.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: Limited or unrestricted network policy, recorded but not enforced: no shipped provider reads it, so a declared limit does not change what a session can reach.

parameters.name: packages
parameters.description: Package manager and package declarations available in this environment. Recorded, not installed: no provider here installs them.

parameters.name: sandbox
parameters.description: Optional sandbox override for sessions using this environment.

title: Update environment
summary: Update an environment template used by future sessions.

title: Archive environment
summary: Archive an environment so it cannot be selected for new sessions.
